861:t_154:8.en:
$$クロウ$$
「To finish, talk skill! Let's go, stop being the quiet type!」

861:t_154:9.en:
$n
「...I guess everyone was that worried about me...」

861:t_154:10.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Oh! The quiet type is picking up speed!」

861:t_154:12.en:
$$ランド$$
「I've been pulling off some great smiles lately!」

861:t_154:13.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Lift your head already. We're getting back to the game.」

861:t_154:15.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Players, you too, do your best along with the Reactors toward the end of 'Super Robot Wars Z'.」

861:t_155:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「This is your old familiar $$ビーター・サービス$$. For all your repair needs, be sure to call us.」

861:t_155:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「This is the combat tech research team $$グローリー・スター$$. Leave the setup of any unit to us.」

861:t_155:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「This is the $$次元獣$$ buster from $$スコート・ラボ$$. If $$次元獣$$s are giving you trouble, call us right away.」

861:t_155:7.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Then shall we pitch in too, in the spirit of volunteering, and help everyone out?」

861:t_155:8.en:
$n
「Repairs, unit setup, and exterminating $$次元獣$$s - all of it!?」

861:t_155:9.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Of course. You're young, so let's give it our all.」

861:t_155:10.en:
$n
「...At this rate, there's no way I'll have time for a break...」

861:t_156:3.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「My name is $$アウストラリス$$. I am the Emperor of the $$新地球皇国$$.」

861:t_156:4.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Earthlings. Train, learn, and better yourselves.」

861:t_156:5.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「And after you rest, once you have regained your strength, challenge me again.」

861:t_156:6.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「I'll be waiting for you in the imperial capital, $$ラース・バビロン$$.」

861:t_157:3.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Super Robot Wars is fun, isn't it?」

861:t_157:4.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「That's because fighting is fun, after all... In short, you players are my kind too, aren't you?」

861:t_157:5.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Come back soon, my darling. Then let's resume our heart-pounding battle.」

861:t_157:6.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I'll be waiting. The next time you meet me on the battlefield, I'll shower you with a kiss of artillery fire!」

861:t_158:6.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「I have nothing in particular to say.」

861:t_158:7.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「But keep playing the game. That is all.」

861:t_159:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Hatred lives in everyone, and it bursts out at the slightest trigger...」

861:t_159:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「When the enemy dodges an attack with over 90% hit rate... when the enemy lands an attack with a single-digit hit rate... people come to hate the game...」

861:t_159:5.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Yes... this 'Super Robot Wars' is a game that builds up hatred.」

861:t_159:6.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I, who stand together with that power, will never lose... no matter how many times you challenge me.」

861:t_159:7.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「If you still say you'll fight, I'll be waiting for the rematch. Heh heh... heh heh heh...」
